beats.say: The Beekeeper 2 teaser is out, and Pom Klementieff has joined the hive.
Amazon MGM Studios released it, with Jason Statham back and Timo Tjahjanto directing.
Writer Kurt Wimmer returns, and so do Jeremy Irons, Jemma Redgrave and Emmy Raver-Lampman.
Wrestler Adam Copeland is new to the cast too.
The first film made 162 million dollars worldwide.
The sequel hits cinemas on 15 January. Who should the Beekeeper take on next?
